name: postman-newman-automation
description: Collaborative API testing for HealthSaaS platform — collections authored as JS, compiled to Postman collection.json, run via Newman.

scripts.test:smoke: newman run collections/auth.collection.json -e environments/staging.environment.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/smoke.html
scripts.test:data-driven: newman run collections/users.collection.json --iteration-data data/users.csv -e environments/staging.environment.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/users-data-driven.html
scripts.test:docker: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up --build --exit-code-from newman newman
